name: Earring of the One
text: While this piece is equipped, {{CHAIRX-001}} no longer reduces your maximum {{pdv}}: every point of {{constitution}}, every Vitality Level and every other source of maximum {{pdv}} grants you as many as it would grant any other character.
description: A blue crystal cut to a point, set in gold at the end of an open hook. Faebie jewellers never cut one alone, and entrust it only to a Scothan.
